character_description: Young adult female in her late 20s, cool and clear voice, precise and confident tone, steady measured pacing, sharp and decisive quality, professional appraiser with icy composure. Studio-quality recording.
audition_line: 珠宝鉴定需要极其精准的眼光，差之毫厘谬以千里。我只在最有把握的时候出手，一旦看准了目标，就会全力以赴，绝不给对手任何机会。这枚翡翠的水头不错，值得关注。
